_note: Weak subjects read from the student's own marks (app/pai_c/understanding/weak_subjects.py; spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-weaknesses-design.md). The marks of one education are read: the current or latest one (paths/fields.py current_education) when it has at least min_courses scored courses, else the next record that does, else the one with the most scored courses (floor rule only). A course is weak when its percent is below absolute_floor_percent, or, with at least min_courses scored courses, at least below_own_average_points under the average of that education's scored courses. A course with a grade letter and no percent or marks reads through grade_percent; any other grade is skipped.
